# AIRIZZ - AI Consulting & Automation for Small and Medium Businesses

AIRIZZ (https://airizz.co) is a premier AI consulting, systems design, and workflow automation agency tailored for small-to-medium businesses (SMBs), traditional trade lines, manufacturing units, and professional services (legal and financial firms) in India. 

We audit manual operational bottlenecks, design lightweight data pipelines, integrate disconnected software systems, and implement custom AI agents to save hours and cut costs.

## Core Products & Services

- [AI Consulting](https://airizz.co/services/ai-consulting) - Operations and workflow audits, ROI calculations, and practical technology roadmap design.
- [Product Engineering](https://airizz.co/services/product-engineering) - End-to-end custom software design, LLM agent integration, and tailor-made business tools.
- [Cusfi](https://airizz.co/products) - Our proprietary AI customer support, lead engagement, and booking engine running on WhatsApp, Web, and SMS.
- [Data Integration](https://airizz.co/services/data-integration) - Unifying inventory systems, CRM, POS, and financial software to resolve fragmented workflows.
- [Marketing Automation](https://airizz.co/services/marketing-automation) - Automated lead nurturing, invoice tracking, client onboarding, and referral management.

## Real-world Case Studies

- [Logistics Billing Automation](https://airizz.co/case-studies/logistics-billing-automation) - Eliminating spreadsheet overhead and integrating CRM for automated bill generation.
- [Legal Client Onboarding](https://airizz.co/case-studies/legal-onboarding-automation) - Speeding up KYC compliance and onboarding document collection for legal practices.
- [Manufacturer Data Unification](https://airizz.co/case-studies/manufacturer-data-unification) - Consolidating disparate ERP records into centralized data stores for business intelligence.

- [Marketing Automation for Legal Firms in India](https://airizz.co/blog/marketing-automation-legal-firms) - Practical strategies to deploy automated response workflows, nurture sequences, and referral tracking for trust-based relationships.
